poster.name: Poster
poster.safe_zone_notes: Keep key content at least 5% from all edges.
poster.text_guidance: Use one short headline and one short CTA; add final text in a design tool.

banner.name: Banner
banner.safe_zone_notes: Reserve a centered safe area for the headline.
banner.text_guidance: Use only five to eight headline words and a short CTA.

story.name: Story (vertical)
story.safe_zone_notes: Avoid top and bottom interface zones; keep text centered.
story.text_guidance: Use one headline line and a short CTA in a design overlay.

square_social_post.name: Square social post
square_social_post.safe_zone_notes: Keep the product and text within a centered safe area.
square_social_post.text_guidance: Use a short headline and short CTA; avoid dense copy.
